description: This file defines a PHP class 'Basic' that extends a system controller and implements CAPTCHA functionality for OpenCart, including generating CAPTCHA images and validating CAPTCHA input.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: A controller class for handling CAPTCHA display and validation in OpenCart

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets language, prepares route data, generates a CAPTCHA token, and returns the CAPTCHA view.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the user's CAPTCHA input against the stored CAPTCHA token in the session.

methods.name: captcha
methods.description: Generates a CAPTCHA image with random noise and stores the CAPTCHA code in the session.
